text:
alina: Starting int4 onboarding runs for qbench v2 today. Need a clean promptset before we kick—de-dupe + golden refresh. planning ~120k cand samples, hold out 2k golden. can we freeze labeling ingest for ~2h this afternoon?

sam: ok from infra side, what time window? i can reserve builders and pin kernel versions. :thumbsup:

alina: aiming 15:30–17:30 UTC. main risks: tokenization mismatch across new tokenizer v3 and sampling overlap with previous holds.

michael: for de-dupe, can we run the new fuzzyhash comparator (threshold 0.82) then a lightweight ngram pass? i saw collisions with 0.9 earlier.

tzara: +1 for 0.82. also suggest we export a 5k quick-check golden subset for manual spotcheck after dedupe. want to sample across intents and longctx.

curation-ops: noted. will schedule dedupe job:
```
job: dedupe-fuzzyhash-v3
threshold: 0.82
shards: 50
sample_quickcheck: 5000
```
Starting at 15:05 UTC so output ready before run.

label-bot: label-queue paused for channel "curation" at 15:20 UTC (automated). React with :white_check_mark: to resume.

sam: pinned runtime image to rwd-infer:2026-03-01-int4, will disable autoscaling during the run. I also set up a canary to fall back to qint8 in case of perf regression.

alina: thanks. michael — can you add a tiny eval harness for quality regression on the 2k golden? just rouge/acc style and a couple targeted hallucination checks.

michael: will do. plan:
- run generation with int4 and qint8 variants on the 2k set
- compute BLEU/ROUGE + hallucination flag from existing detectors
- emit per-prompt diffs and top 20 regressions
I'll post results to thread.

curation-ops: small ask — any labels in flight with >10% incomplete should be re-queued before 15:10. i can run a soft drain.

tzara: i'll take manual spotcheck of the 5k quickcheck. will report any high-variance buckets (multilang/longcase).

alina: perfect. if int4 shows >2% quality drop on the golden we abort and fallback. also we need token-level cost delta report. deploy-bot, can you attach cost estimate?

deploy-bot: cost-estimate attached: int4 run (120k samples) est tokens 28M -> est compute $420 (gpu-hours 6.2). qint8 fallback est $560. (quickcheck and golden included).

sam: all set. i'll disable label ingestion at 15:20, start dedupe at 15:05, and kick the int4 run at 15:30.

alina: thanks everyone — keep thread lean during run, only post regressions or blockers. :pray:

michael: posting initial quickcheck results in ~30m, will highlight top diffs.
